decision.reason: [ev-8cb5385bf897] is a single changelog line saying only that "a sentence" was rephrased in PR #22113. It doesn't say which sentence, or whether it sits in docs, a CLI help string, a UI label or a log/error message. Without that, the subject, the type of change and who is exposed can't be written down. P2's guess that this is documentation is not supported by the evidence. We need the PR #22113 diff or description to see which text changed and where it is shown.
